notes.title: Demo 2.0 starts now! New warriors arrive!
notes.content:
Hello warriors! Disputes over the Nile reignited, Let's keep protecting this land. Demo of the Warriors of the Nile 2 is officially launched. Besides of the original three basic warriors, this time we will bring you a new warriors, Rite of Red Scorpion. You only need to clear demo once to unlock this powerful mage character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283587/a450a6a141ab35537cdaeec26d727f6b6b188ab4.png[/img]

 The developments about Warriors of the Nile 2 is also at the last minute. In order to ensure that the game can be launched on time in the third quarter, we will continue to invest in developments. I'm sorry for making you wait for a long time. I hope this new demo and new warriors can make you feel the new charm about Warriors of the Nile 2.

In addition to new warriors, the demo 2.0 also temporarily opened some functions. Of course, it's not complete, Join the Discord server
https://discord.gg/uykMdxD 
if you have any thoughts you want to share with us.

notes.title: Warriors of the Nile 2 DEMO is available now & Early Access Preview
notes.content:
Warriors, the army of Rome is coming! Take up your arms, sense the power of the gods and resist enemy's invasion!

In Warriors of the Nile 2 DEMO, you can try four characters and one full level. Elite enemies in easy mode and plenty of random tablet skills can bring you a different experience for each game. Have fun! If you find any bugs and have feedback related to the game, please join https://discord.gg/uykMdxD and talk it to us.

It has been more than a year since the release of Warriors of the Nile. When the sequel was announced, we received a lot of enthusiastic feedback combined with questions. The following contents may relieve some of your questions about the Early Access version of Warriors of the Nile in advance.

-Nine unique characters. In Warriors of the Nile, only the base tablet (skills) cam be changed. However, in the DEMO of Warriors of the Nile2, the nine characters have their exclusive tablets for you to combine your very own skill combo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006428/ea68ff0cb56ffaa7a87e1b9d955c2cf3df5b3024.png[/img]

-Exclusive talent trees. Use the permanent points to enhance and develop your characters!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006428/44114eabb80c84a5c720a712c17ced8dfe9ae5ee.png[/img]

-Equipment system. Hundreds of weapons and dozens of accessories are waiting for its warrior.

-The talisman system (TBD). Talismans can be inlay to upgrade and strengthen weapons and equipment.

-Elite enemies. The battlefield is full of crises. Should you wait or merch on? Use your strategic mind and judge calmly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006428/72e060d3bafcc73fd42b73ff03d05f6c4a9e28ee.png[/img]

We have also implemented some of our regrets in the previous game and researching on the Steam Workshop and Endless Mode make Warriors of the Nile2 present in a better status.

In order to thank all players who support the game series, all players who own Warriors of the Niles will enjoy a royal discount when buying Warriors of the Nile2. In addition to the discount, players who already own the previous game before December 31, 2021 will also receive a non-sale exclusive skin.

Wishlist us is the best support for us, thank you! Stay tuned!

notes.title: We’re back with Warriors of the Nile 2
notes.content:
Hey Warriors,

It’s quite a long time since the last announcement. We miss you badly!

We have heard some voices that said we have abandoned the game. Don’t worry, it will never happen! In fact, we adjusted the team during that time, studying the pros and cons of the original Warriors of the Nile, to bring you a better sequel.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682060/][h3][b]Go to Warriors of the Nile 2 Store Page[/b][/h3][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682060/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283587/2b6028bc684ccda5077a9c6bb3c096e5614fb798.jpg[/img][/url]

Based on Roguelite x Strategy gameplay, Warriors of the Nile 2 will bring much more content and randomness. Every playable character will have his/her unique system which could be the game-changer at the crucial moment! More details will be revealed during Tokyo Game Show.

At last, thank you all for your support! August 7th will be the anniversary of Warriors of the Nile’s release, we will celebrate it with a -40% discount for the game.

See you soon!

notes.content:
After fixing tons of bugs at launch, this time we spent a little longer time bringing you some brand new content of Warriors of the Nile. These include new carvings and gears. In addition a new hero morph Yu Qing, which designed by the player '梦回仙灵' who won the Demo Speedrun conpetition, officially joined the warriors squad.

[b]Update log v1.0202[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 5 new carvings
[*] Added 6 new gears
[*] Adjusted the layout of hero morph interface and added detailed information of warriors
[*] Added new archer hero morph Yu Qing

notes.title: Update log v1.0101 - Gears can be sold now
notes.content:
It has been almost two weeks after Warriors of the Nile launched. Apophis has been defeated by Warriors for countless times. We just want to say thanks again to everyone of you who has endured and reported bugs to us.

[b]In the latest update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can sell gears to trader for money
[*] Golds have new uses - to refresh gears from trader
[*] Finally you can check gears collection in your citadel
[*] Of course, some bugs are fixed
[/list]

[b]What will happen later:[/b]
[list]
[*] New hero morphs and collaboration content is scheduled to be out in September, maybe more than you expect
[*] We will attend PAX Online
[*] And more are coming...
[/list]

Well, you know that new features always mean new bu...so don't hesitate to tell us when you found any problems!


Stove Studio

notes.title: First week summary - Thank you all & Future plans
notes.content:
Warriors of the Nile has launched for a week, just feel like a year has passed. Here we want to say thank you to everyone who likes and supports our game. It's impossible for us to make it without your support and the bugs you've found in the game. Both the praise and criticism mean a lot for us.

We hope Warriors of the Nile could bring you more enjoyment in the future, so we will keep updating and adding more content. We've already received so many interesting ideas, but you know, we're a really small team of two man. We just need a littile break to analyze your feedbacks and make them into executable development plans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38283587/613860c559bf5a01d8f927dfda2164cdcc82e867.jpg[/img]

——————————————————————————————————

[b]The confirmed update plans[/b]
.Gears can be sold to trader (as soon as next week)
.Add gears collection (as soon as next week)
.Add new hero morphs
.Add new levels
.Adjust general difficulty

We will release more information about future content in September if things are going well, so that you can know the direction of Warriors of the Nile. Of course, we will keep fixing bugs as well.

Stove Studio

notes.title: Warriors of the Nile is out now! Enjoy 10% off release discount this week
notes.content:
Dear Warriors,

We're thrilling to announce that Warriors of the Nile is officially released. This is a roguelike tactical game made by a two-man team. We both love strategy games, that's why we created Warriors of the Nile. We sincerely hope that you enjoy the game.

Unlke most traditional strategy games, Warriors of the Nile provides a faster-paced combat experience. On top of that the roguelite mechanics allow players be able to try different builds each time.

Join the [b][url=https://discord.gg/uykMdxD]Discord[/url][/b] server if you have any thoughts you want to share with us.

notes.title: Developer's Time Challenge! Put yourself into the game
notes.content:
The developer himself is giving a away the opportunity for you to become a part of his game along with Steam credits!
Check out the details here.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
First place: Create your own warrior avatar for the full version of "Warriors of the Nile".
2nd to 10th place: Winners get a $20USD Steam store gift card!

[h3]Duration[/h3]
The event starts from today August 3rd ending on August 7th 02:00 AM PDT (UTC -7) time.
What you have to do:
1. Download and play the Free Demo version of "Warriors of the Nile" before the deadline.
4. Everyday we'll be posting the highest rankings from the previous day.our run. Plus a screenshot displaying the end results screen. (Image in the comments for reference)
3. Send the video and screenshots to contact@gameragame.com
4. You can repeat the challenge anytime before the deadline to update your newest best score.
5. Remember to write your Steam ID along with your Facebook profile link when sending the email so that we can contact you and display you as the winner.
6. If there's a time tie between two competitors, priority will be given to the champion who sends their score to the email first.

[h3]Notes[/h3]
1. It is forbidden to use tools such as modifiers and game speed hacks.
2. The Demo version doesn't have a save function so you'll have to clear it in one go.
3. The Demo version doesn't reflect the quality of the final official version.
4. Evereyday we'll be posting the highest rankings from the previous day.
5. By submitting to this contest you agree to allow us to use your submitted gameplay video for promotional purposes.
6. GameraGame reserves all the rights to interpret this event's rules and guidelines.

[h3]Tips[/h3]
1. You can join the official Discord group (https://discord.com/invite/uykMdxD) to learn more about the game and events with devs and players.
2. Remember to wishlist "Warriors of the Nile" the full version will be released on August 7th 02:00 AM PDT (UTC -7) time.)
